nodes.name: 4.3.3 Trigger - Reply Event In
nodes.notes: Called via Execute Workflow from 4.3.1 (Waha inbound webhook, after its Postgres update) and 4.3.2 (LinkedIn poll, after its Postgres update). Also intended for 2.1's existing email-reply webhook to be re-pointed here (see integration note in README) so all three channels funnel through one suppression path instead of each module patching clients_master separately.

nodes.notes: workflow_errors table per SKILL §16.3 schema. Requires that table to already exist (Phase 3.0 error-handling work) - flag as REQUIRES SCHEMA CONFIRMATION if 3.0's workflow_errors table has not actually been created yet.

nodes.name: Insert communication_events
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SCHEMA CONFIRMATION if communication_events (§16.5) has not been created on the live DB yet - CREATE TABLE statement is in the companion schema-setup node below, run once before this goes live.

parameters.query:
-- 4.3.3.1 (part 4) + 4.3.3.2 - this IS the 'merge channels' step: whichever channel replied last wins last_reply_channel/at,
-- and this is what makes the lead stop qualifying for 2.2 Nurture's due-lead query (see integration note in README)
UPDATE clients_master
SET last_reply_channel = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate & Normalize Reply Signal').item.json.channel) }},
    last_reply_at = {{ JSON.stringify($('Validate & Normalize Reply Signal').item.json.occurred_at) }}::timestamp,
    active_sequence_suppressed = true,
    status = CASE WHEN status IN ('Contacted','Nurtured') THEN 'Replied' ELSE status END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = {{ $json.client_id }}
RETURNING id, odoo_lead_id, status, last_reply_channel, last_reply_at, active_sequence_suppressed;

nodes.name: Update clients_master (reply + suppress)
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SCHEMA CONFIRMATION for active_sequence_suppressed column if the §16.4 ALTER TABLE hasn't been run yet - see schema-setup node.

parameters.query:
-- 4.3.3.0 - one-time schema setup, run manually before first live execution (NOT part of the per-event runtime path)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS communication_events (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  client_id INTEGER REFERENCES clients_master(id),
  channel TEXT,
  direction TEXT,
  content TEXT,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now(),
  workflow_source TEXT
);
ALTER TABLE clients_master ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS active_sequence_suppressed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S5.3 — reports the merged reply (whichever channel it came from) to Hub-Intake as event_type: reply.received, right after the single clients_master update this workflow already does. Fires regardless of which channel (email/whatsapp/linkedin) sent the reply, since all 3 route through this one node once 4.3.1/4.3.2 are rewired to call this workflow (see README — rewiring itself is a separate, not-yet-done step).
